hooks.name: check trap code on save

action.prompt: Using the project's .venv, run ruff check on trap and tests, bandit -r trap -ll, and pytest -q. Report any failures briefly with the file and line, and suggest the fix. Do not edit files unless I ask.

hooks.description: When a Python file in trap/ or tests/ is saved, run ruff, bandit and pytest and report any failures.
